description: Manual classifier ground-truth overrides keyed by absolute URL. Use for cases where column+URL heuristics are insufficient or HEAD-dependent. expected_type must be a classifier strategy (not a generator name).

https://sh.rustup.rs.rationale: Official Rustup installer endpoint; has_script_install column and serves a shell script (extensionless host).

https://get.jetify.com/devbox.rationale: Devbox install endpoint advertised as curl|bash; extensionless installer host.

https://get.volta.sh.rationale: Bare install domain without path/extension; classify stays unknown offline (HEAD may not upgrade).

https://get.docker.com.rationale: Docker convenience script install URL (curl|bash), even without .sh extension.
